words.sentence: I can't see the bridge because of the fog.
words.def: This is like a cloud near the ground. You cannot see far.

words.sentence: There was a big storm last night.
words.def: This weather has strong wind, heavy rain and sometimes thunder.

words.sentence: The lightning lit up the sky.
words.def: In a storm, this bright light flashes in the sky.
You hear this loud noise in a storm.
